# Attnd

> Attnd turns an event's website, flyer or spreadsheet into a live event app: a map of every place, the schedule,
> push updates and an on-device assistant for attendees, kept in sync as the organizer edits. Free to try for
> organizers; attendees join by scanning a QR code (iPhone App Clip, nothing to install, or the Android app).

Attnd is for organizers of festivals, markets, fairs, conferences, races, art walks and other events where people
move between several places. Organizers build the event with AI from their existing website or flyer, edit it in the
console (or by asking Attnd's assistant), preview changes on their own phone and publish them to attendees.

## Key pages

- [Home](https://attnd.app/): what Attnd does, live examples, "Try it on your event"
- [Privacy policy](https://attnd.app/privacy/)
- Join an event: `https://attnd.app/join/<EVENT CODE>/` (opens the app or App Clip; the code is on the event's QR code)
- [Attnd on the App Store](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/attnd/id1470627406)
- [Attnd on Google Play](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.arcu.attnd)

## Support

Organizers reach the Attnd team from the console's assistant ("Talk to a person", or type /contact).
